DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 夕方まで園内にいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be staying in the park until evening?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池の夕焼けを撮りたいです。暗くなってから出られる出口はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕景撮影後に使える出口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to photograph the sunset over the pond. Is there an exit I can use after dark?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which exit you can use after photographing the evening view. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は六時にすべての門を閉めます。日没を待つと遅くなるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: All gates close at six today. Waiting until sunset may be too late.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら夕焼けの途中で切り上げます。池から門まではどのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 閉門前の切上げと門までの距離を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will stop partway through the sunset. How long is it from the pond to the gate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Discuss stopping before gate closure and the distance to the gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 東門なら五分ほどです。ただ、木道は補修中で通れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The east gate is about five minutes away. However, the boardwalk is closed for repairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 舗装された道から東門へ戻れますか。カメラの荷物が重いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 補修道を避け舗装路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can I return to the east gate along a paved path? My camera equipment is heavy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a paved route avoiding the repaired path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 池の南側を通れば、階段なしで戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Going along the south side of the pond lets you return without stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その道を帰りに使います。三脚は池の柵の内側に置いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路を選び三脚の場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use that route back. May I place my tripod inside the pond fence?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the return route and check the tripod position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 柵の内側には入れません。通路の幅を空けて外側でお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You cannot go inside the fence. Use it outside, keeping the path wide enough for people to pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 外側から撮って、五時四十五分に片付けます。南側の道で東門へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影位置片付け時刻と帰路を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will photograph from outside and pack up at five forty-five. I will return to the east gate along the southern path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide your shooting position, packing-up time and return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お時間に気をつけて、どうぞ撮影をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28226-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch the time and enjoy your photography.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換えの時刻をご確認ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今夜の最終列車で帰ります。青川駅で三分の乗換えですが、間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 終電の短い乗換え時間を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going home on tonight's last train. I have a three-minute transfer at Aokawa. Can I make it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the short transfer time for the last train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 到着は二番線、出発は四番線です。通路を渡るので余裕は少ないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You arrive on platform two and depart on four. You cross the passage, so there is little spare time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きな鞄もあります。乗り遅れたら、その先へ行く列車はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物と接続を逃した場合の列車を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I also have a large bag. If I miss it, are there no further trains onwards?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about your luggage and trains after a missed connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この時刻では最終です。ここから一本前に出る方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: At that time it is the last service. You could also take one earlier train from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その列車なら、青川で何分待つことになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一本早い列車の待ち時間を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: With that train, how long would I wait at Aokawa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the wait with the earlier train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二十分あります。待合室でお待ちになれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Twenty minutes. You can wait in the waiting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら一本前に乗ります。青川で待合室を出る時、四番線へはどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 早めると決め待合室からの移動を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will take the earlier one. At Aokawa, which way is platform four when leaving the waiting room?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose an earlier train and ask the route from the waiting room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待合室の正面に番線案内があります。四番線への階段は右です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is a platform guide opposite the waiting room. The stairs for platform four are on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今の予定を早めて、青川では案内板を見て四番線へ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出発を早め接続先の番線へ移ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will leave earlier than planned and follow the signs at Aokawa to platform four.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave earlier and move to the connecting platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが一本前の時刻です。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the earlier departure time. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書をお取りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here for a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住宅の申込みに住民票が必要です。私一人の分か、世帯全員の分か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住宅用住民票の対象人数を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need a residence record for a housing application. I do not know whether it should cover just me or everyone in the household.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how many people should appear on a housing residence record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the recipient's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。「入居する方全員」とあります。家族三人で引っ越します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内を示し入居予定人数を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This paper. It says “everyone moving in”. Our family of three is moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the instructions and give the planned number of residents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 世帯全員の証明が合うか、提出先へ確認しましょう。こちらの電話からおかけになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check with the recipient whether an all-household certificate fits. Would you like to use this telephone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の携帯で担当に聞きます。本籍の記載も必要か、一緒に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先へ対象と記載項目を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask the person in charge on my mobile. I will check whether registered domicile details are needed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the people and required fields with the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。確認できましたら、記載項目を申請用紙で選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. After confirmation, you can select the fields on the application form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当につながりました。三人分で、本籍と個人番号は不要と言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認した三人分と不要項目を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I reached the person in charge. They said all three people, with neither registered domicile nor individual identification numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the confirmed three people and unnecessary fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ではその条件を用紙に記入してください。必要な通数は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then enter those conditions on the form. Do you know how many copies?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一通です。三人の載ったものを、本籍と個人番号なしで申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件と通数を指定して申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: One. I will apply for a record showing three people, without registered domicile or individual identification numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apply specifying the conditions and number of copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申請をお預かりします。お手続きありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the application. Thank you for completing the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票で分からない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any unclear parts of the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「発症時期」という欄は、病院に来ることを決めた日ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診の発症時期の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does the “onset” field mean the day I decided to come to hospital?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what onset means on the questionnaire. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最初に症状が出た時期です。どの症状でいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It means when symptoms first appeared. What symptoms brought you here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手首の痛みです。一週間くらい前ですが、正確な日を思い出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 症状と日付の不確かさを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Wrist pain. About a week ago, but I cannot remember the exact day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the symptom and uncertainty about the date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: おおよその時期と、その後の変化を書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write the approximate time and changes since then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初は荷物を持つ時だけでした。昨日から何もしていなくても痛みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 痛みの変化を時系列で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: At first it only hurt when carrying things. Since yesterday it hurts even when I do nothing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the change in pain chronologically. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その変化も書くと、診察で伝えやすくなります。けがをした覚えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Writing that change will help explain it during consultation. Do you remember any injury?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 転んではいません。先週から、重い箱を運ぶ仕事が増えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: けがの有無と作業の変化を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not fallen. Since last week, my work carrying heavy boxes has increased.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer about injury and changes in work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのことも添えてください。痛む側も記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Add that too. Let us also write which side hurts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右手首です。一週間前からで、昨日悪化したと書きます。仕事のことも先生に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部位時期悪化と仕事を記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My right wrist. I will write that it began a week ago and worsened yesterday. I will tell the doctor about work too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record location, onset, worsening and work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書けましたら受付へお出しください。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: When finished, hand it to reception. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不審な連絡について伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will ask about the suspicious contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 未払い料金のメールを開いて、名前と住所を入力してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不審メールへの個人情報入力を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I opened an unpaid-fee email and entered my name and address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report entering personal information through a suspicious email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払いや、カード情報の入力もしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you also pay or enter card details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お金は払っていません。カード番号は入れずに画面を閉じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未払いとカード情報未入力を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not paid. I closed the screen without entering the card number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain no payment and no card information entered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: メールと送信元が分かる画面は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you still have the email and a screen identifying the sender?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。後で電話も来ましたが、出ていません。着信番号も見せられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メールと後続の着信記録を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. There was a phone call afterwards too, but I did not answer. I can show the incoming number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the email and subsequent call record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録を確認します。その後はリンクへ入力せず、連絡も続けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the records. Do not enter anything through the link or continue contacting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メールを消す前に保存します。住所を入れたことも、相談の記録に残してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録保存と住所入力の記載を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will save the email before deleting it. Could you also record in the consultation that I entered my address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to preserve records and note the address disclosure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、入力した情報を伺います。相談担当へそのままお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we will ask what information you entered. Tell the consultation officer exactly that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と住所だけです。メールと着信履歴を見せて、今後の対応を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入力範囲を明示して対応相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only my name and address. I want to show the email and call history and discuss what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify the information entered and request advice on further action. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの担当席へどうぞ。お越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to this officer's desk. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending a parcel, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さいギターです。このソフトケースのまま送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 楽器のソフトケース発送を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A small guitar. Can I send it in this soft case as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about shipping an instrument in a soft case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 輸送用の外箱と緩衝材をご用意ください。ケースの中でも楽器が動きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please prepare an outer shipping box and cushioning. Does the instrument move inside the case too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し動きます。新聞紙を外に巻いただけでは足りませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケース内の動きと簡易保護を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: A little. Is just wrapping newspaper around the outside not enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Discuss movement inside the case and simple protection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 硬い箱で保護し、隙間を埋める必要があります。弦や付属品もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: A rigid box and filled gaps are necessary. Are there strings or accessories too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 替えの弦と調整用の道具があります。小袋にまとめて箱へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 付属品を分けて梱包すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Spare strings and adjustment tools. I will put them together in a small bag inside the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will pack accessories separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 道具が楽器に当たらないよう別に固定してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Secure the tools separately so they do not hit the instrument.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は箱を買って家で詰め直します。大きさが変わるので料金も後で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 梱包を持ち帰って直し料金確認を後にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I will buy a box and repack at home. The size will change, so I want to check the price afterwards too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take it home for repacking and postpone the fee check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 完成した状態でお持ちいただければ、寸法を測ってご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Bring it fully packed, and we will measure it and advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。外箱と中の固定を直し、ふたを閉じる前の写真も撮っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保護固定を改善し状態を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will improve the outer box and internal fastening, and photograph it before closing the lid too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Improve protection and fastening and record the packed condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: またお待ちしております。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you again. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みの受付ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to make a transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工事代金を払うのですが、請求書の口座名義が契約した会社と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社名と異なる振込先を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am paying for construction, but the account holder on the invoice differs from the company I contracted with.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a transfer recipient different from the company name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お手元の書類を拝見できますか。振込先の連絡はどこから来ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see your documents? Where did the bank details come from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社を名乗るメールです。今月から別の口座になったと書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類と変更通知メールの経緯を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: An email claiming to be the company. It says the account changed from this month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the documents and explain the account-change email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先に、契約書にある連絡先から会社へ確認することをお勧めします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We recommend checking with the company first using the contact on the contract.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このメールへの返信ではなく、前から知っている番号へ電話します。今日は振込を待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既知の連絡先で確認し振込延期を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Instead of replying to this email, I will call the number I already know. Can I postpone today's transfer?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check through a known contact and request postponing the transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ受付していませんので、用紙はお返しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so we can return the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返してください。会社に口座変更の有無と、名義が違う理由を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用紙返却と確認する内容を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please return it. I will ask the company whether the account changed and why the holder differs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the form back and state what you will check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が取れてから、振込内容をご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Prepare the transfer details after you have confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。確認できるまでお金は動かしません。請求書と契約書を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認まで送金せず資料を持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not move money until it is confirmed. I will take the invoice and contract home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not send money until confirmed, and take the documents home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書類をお返しします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your documents. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はお済みですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。仕事で使うお茶を買いました。領収書をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入後に仕事用領収書を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I bought tea for work. Could I have an official receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a work receipt after purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レシートを拝見します。お茶以外の商品もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the till receipt. There are items besides tea too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パンは私の分です。お茶だけの金額にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 私物を除いた金額を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bread is for me. Can the official receipt cover only the tea amount?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request an amount excluding personal purchases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入内容を担当が確認します。宛名はどのようにしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the purchase. What name should appear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「川辺設計事務所」でお願いします。漢字をこの紙に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名を指定し表記を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: “Kawabe Design Office”, please. I will write the kanji on this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the recipient name and show the spelling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お茶だけの金額で発行できることを確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We confirmed we can issue it for the tea alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。レシートも返してもらえますか。家計の記録に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家計用レシートの返却を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Could I also get the till receipt back? I use it for my household records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the till receipt back for household accounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発行済みの印を付けてお返しします。こちらが領収書です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will mark it as issued and return it. Here is the official receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛名とお茶の金額が合っています。領収書は会社用、レシートは自分用に分けてしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名金額を確認し二つの証拠書類を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The name and tea amount are correct. I will store the official receipt for the company separately from the till receipt for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check name and amount and separate the two supporting documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お渡しする物は以上です。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: That is everything to hand over. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to see the guide map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 谷の奥まで歩く予定です。空が暗くなってきましたが、途中に雨宿りできる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 奥の散歩道の雨宿り場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to walk to the far end of the valley. The sky is getting dark; is there somewhere to shelter from rain along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for rain shelter along the trail into the valley. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 奥の道には建物がありません。今日は山側で雨が降り始めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are no buildings along the inner path. Rain has started on the mountain side today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら奥へ行くのはやめます。管理棟の周りだけ歩けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 雨を踏まえ管理棟周辺に変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will not go further in. Can I walk just around the management building?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Change to the management building area because of rain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花壇を回る道なら五分ほどで戻れます。屋根のある通路もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The flowerbed loop takes about five minutes back. There is also a covered passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 傘を持っていないので、屋根の通路から花壇を見るだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 傘がないため屋根の通路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have no umbrella, so I will just look at the flowerbeds from the covered passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the covered passage because you have no umbrella. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路は向こうです。床がぬれている所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The passage is over there. Parts of the floor are wet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ゆっくり歩きます。出口に近いのは、通路のどちら側ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ぬれた床に配慮し出口側を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will walk slowly. Which end of the passage is closer to the exit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider the wet floor and ask which side leads to the exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 左の端が正門側です。バス停も正門を出てすぐです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The left end is towards the main gate. The bus stop is just outside that gate too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左の端まで行って、雨が強くなる前に正門からバス停へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路から正門とバス停へ戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will go to the left end and head through the main gate to the bus stop before the rain gets heavy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to return from the passage via the main gate to the bus stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 短い道でお気をつけて。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28227-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care on the short route. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 接続の列車をお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting for a connecting train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。次の列車が遅れると、青川駅で予約した特急に間に合いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延で予約した接続に間に合わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If the next train is delayed, I will miss the limited express I reserved at Aokawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the delay means you cannot make your reserved connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 指定券を拝見します。青川での乗換えは何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the reserved ticket. What time is the connection at Aokawa?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十二時十分です。今の遅れでは着くのが十二時二十分になりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 接続時刻と遅延後の到着見込みを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Twelve ten. With the present delay, it looks as though arrival will be twelve twenty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the connection time and estimated delayed arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 間に合わない見込みですね。出発前に変更の窓口でご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It looks unlikely you will make it. Before departure, you can discuss changes at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予約した座席だけ変更できますか。行き先は変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行先維持で座席変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can I change just my reserved seat? I am keeping the same destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss a seat change with the destination unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更できる内容を窓口で確認します。到着時刻の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The counter will confirm what can be changed. Do you have a preferred arrival time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二時までに着きたいです。次の特急の席がなければ、普通列車の経路も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着期限と代替の普通列車も希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to arrive by two. If the next limited express has no seats, I want to ask about a local-train route too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your arrival deadline and request a local-train alternative too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二つの希望をお伝えください。窓口はこのホームの階段を上がった先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell them both wishes. The counter is up the stairs from this platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 列車を待つより先に相談します。指定券を持って、二時までの経路を調べてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車前に券を持って変更窓口へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will consult before waiting for the train. I will bring the reserved ticket and ask them to find a route arriving by two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the ticket to the changes counter before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ窓口へ。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the counter. Take care on your way.
